title: ReviewFixtureEnvelope
description: A synthetic, machine-generated review envelope used ONLY to test the mechanics of the review export -> import -> finalize pipeline (hash/schema validation, atomic import, deterministic finalize). It is not a review: fixture.substantive_review_performed is always false, and it must never be importable as if it were a human review (see schemas/review-envelope.schema.json) or accepted without the operator explicitly passing --allow-test-fixture to `demand-radar review import`. Only importable into a run explicitly marked test_fixture=true in its task.yaml, never into a normal or canonical run, and never mixed with real human reviews in the same run.

generator.description: Identifies what produced this fixture, e.g. 'demand-radar-review-smoke' (the CLI's own `review generate-fixtures` command).

purpose.description: The only purpose this contract supports. A fixture is never a stand-in for a review of any other kind.

substantive_review_performed.description: Always false by construction -- a fixture that claimed otherwise would be a contradiction in terms.

opportunity_hash.description: Hash of the OpportunityCard as exported. review import re-derives this from the current store and rejects the envelope if it no longer matches (stale or tampered).

evidence_manifest_hash.description: Hash of the evidence.jsonl exported for this card. Re-derived and checked the same way as opportunity_hash.

recommended_status.description: review import rejects any fixture verdict that recommends experiment_ready -- a synthetic fixture must never be able to push a card toward the one status that claims real validation, regardless of what a fixture generator sends.

evidence_ids.description: Must belong to the opportunity card under review -- review import rejects an objection evidence_id that exists but belongs to a different card.
